name: skeleton
description: A soft placeholder in the shape of content that is still loading: lines of text, an avatar, an image or a card. Use it when the layout of what's coming is known, so the page doesn't jump when it arrives; for a wait with no known shape, use a spinner. Screen readers skip it, so set aria-busy="true" on the region that is loading. Mirror the real layout: the same rows, the same avatar size, the same number of lines.

props.name: variant
props.description: text stands for lines of text at the size of the text around it; circle for an avatar; block for an image or card and fills the box it is put in, so give that box a size.

props.name: lines
props.description: Only for text: how many lines. The last one is shorter, as a paragraph's is.

props.name: size
props.description: Only for circle: its diameter. Match the avatar it stands for.
